name: hf
description: `hfagent` is a minimal, opencode-style CLI coding agent powered by Hugging Face Inference (OpenAI-compatible router). It is a hands-on companion to the [Hugging Face AI Agents Course](https://huggingface.co/learn/agents-course): it implements the course's core loop — **Thought → Action → Observation** — as a real tool-calling agent that can read, search, edit files and run commands in your project.
